alert_rules_desc: Prometheus rules over the platform and rollout metrics, evaluated against this group right now. Nebraska does not send notifications: load these into Prometheus and route them through Alertmanager.
alert_rules_note: Evaluated in the browser from live instance data. Once the per-OEM metrics are exported, Prometheus evaluates the identical expressions server-side.
group_delete_confirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this group?
no_groups_yet: There are no groups for this application yet.<1/><2/>Groups help you control how you want to distribute updates to a specific set of instances.
platform_distribution_desc: Reported by each instance on check-in. Cross-tabulated against update status to expose platform-specific failures.
track_identifier: Track (identifier for clients, filled with the group ID if omitted)
update_policy_single_instance: Only update 1 instance at a time, and stop if an update fails.
